# Meme Lab — expanded brief

Site: https://memes.significanthobbies.com
Canonical name: Meme Lab

## What it is

Meme Lab is a personal meme picker built and maintained by Sarthak Agrawal.
A user pastes one complete comment or situation; the product returns the
best-matching meme first, four honestly ranked backups, ordinal fit labels,
and an honest confidence level.

## Catalogue

- 3,000 references total: 1,805 named meme templates and 1,195 usage-backed
  reaction GIFs.
- GIFs come from the GIF Reply research dataset (1.56M observed
  conversation-to-GIF replies); each selected GIF has at least 108 observed
  uses.
- Every record carries message, relational pattern, example context,
  near-miss context, tags, media type, preview/source URLs, provenance,
  evidence state, and rights state.
- A checked-in 41-item canonical coverage manifest tracks recognizable gaps.

## How matching works

- Two BGE embedding views (meaning, example) over a Cloudflare Vectorize
  index; reciprocal-rank fusion; 10 of 30 shortlist slots reserved for the
  original core set.
- TypeSafe Jev scores all 30 candidates on five ordered fit levels in one
  request; scores map to public fit labels.
- Multi-person comments run three lenses (My reaction, Their side, The
  situation) with a final ordinal rescore.
- Serious help, grief, apology, care, and factual requests are abstained
  on before humour is considered.
- If Jev is rate-limited, five semantic-retrieval matches are returned with
  low confidence; no large text-generation model is substituted.

## Pages

- / — the picker
- /collection — searchable catalogue
- /how-it-works — retrieval, ranking, evaluation notes
- /memes/{id} — one reference page per catalogued meme (append .md for Markdown)

## Agent surfaces

- /api/ai — JSON catalog of machine-readable surfaces
- /llms.txt — summary and link map
- /index.md, /collection.md, /how-it-works.md — Markdown alternates
- /memes/{id}.md — Markdown per meme record
- Accept: text/markdown is honored on all HTML and meme pages
- /sitemap.xml — 3,003 public URLs; /robots.txt — allows all, disallows /api/

## Privacy

Submitted comments are used only for the recommendation, never placed in
public URLs, metadata, page source, or the sitemap. One-tap feedback is kept
30 days and pruned daily.

## Evaluation caveats

Labels are assistant-authored and not human-validated; metrics are
directional. See /how-it-works for the shadow-set methodology.

Maintainer: Sarthak Agrawal — https://sarthakagrawal.dev
